episodes.title: The Second Son
episodes.summary: Mary Villiers plots to change her family's fortunes, but must convince her son George to rise to the occasion.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.summary: Mary resorts to drastic measures to help her son impress the king. George attempts to stand out from the crowd.

episodes.title: Not So Much As Love As By Awe
episodes.summary: As Somerset puts George under pressure, Mary must find a way to persevere or risk losing everything.

episodes.title: The Wolf & the Lamb
episodes.summary: Mary goes head-to-head with Lady Hatton, while George faces a daunting and dangerous trip to Scotland.

episodes.title: The Golden City
episodes.summary: A political crisis is triggered by the return of the legendary Sir Walter Raleigh, driving a wedge between Mary, George and King James.

episodes.title: The Queen Is Dead
episodes.summary: George risks everything as he navigates the affairs of the state, while Mary faces her own dire consequences.

episodes.title: War
episodes.summary: George and Charles embark on a monumental and historical trip to Spain. Mary attempts one last throw of the dice to ensure absolute power. Series finale.
